results.title: Funded Research - Wharton AI & Analytics Initiative
results.content: Recently, Wharton AI and Analytics Initiative funded a project to study “Reducing Gender and Racial Disparities in the Use of Generative AI in the Workplace.” While this research intends to enhance both academic research and practice over the longer-term, there is an immediate need to ensure that the “digital divide” in AI adoption does not manifest (or widen) among students enrolled in the courses, MGMT 2240 and MGMT 6240, Leading Diversity in Organizations. This research project aims to investigate the impact of artificial intelligence (AI) investments by non-tech firms (AI-adopters) on product market competition, innovation, and industry dynamics. With proprietary data from Upwork Inc., the researchers are able to access full information on a large sample of jobs and workers over time, thus obtaining findings that can inform the effects of generative AI on the labor market and careers.

results.title: Online Accelerated Master's in Public Health Education at SOU
results.content: - MSEd with a Concentration in Public Health Education Online. - MSEd with a Concentration in Public Health Education Online. Become a leader in public health and work toward building healthy communities with the Master of Science in Education with a Concentration in Public Health Education online program at Southern Oregon University. This multidisciplinary program includes 100 percent online courses in education, health, and business to help you develop the competencies necessary to address public health issues in your community. Our MSEd with a Concentration in Public Health Education online program features the same affordable, pay-as-you-go tuition for all in-state and out-of-state students. The MSEd in Public Health Education online program is designed to be flexible for busy professionals. MSEd with a Concentration in Public Health Education Online Admission Requirements. *\*\*The MSEd with a Concentration in Public Health Education includes two MBA courses in the program that have a cost of $430 per credit, and total cost of $1,730 per course.*.
